description: This Python source file defines a set of FastAPI route handlers for provider-specific pass-through endpoints in a machine learning application. It includes routes for various LLM providers like Anthropic, Vertex AI, Cohere, Milvus, Mistral, Bedrock, AssemblyAI, and OpenAI, facilitating proxying requests to external APIs while managing credentials, streaming, and model routing logic. It also contains utility functions for handling Vertex AI and Bedrock-specific proxy logic, including model extraction, credential management, and request forwarding.
